name: electric-power curated domain knowledge
license: MIT (original project curation; third-party sources retain their terms)
scope: Database-neutral business semantics; bounded synthetic industry scenarios
authority: Project-curated modeling guidance and synthetic examples, not official standard axioms or operational authority

records.name: 设备、端子与连接点
records.summary: Keep equipment identity separate from its terminals and versioned connection points; a connectivity relation alone does not prove energization.

records.name: 拓扑版本
records.summary: Select one compatible topology snapshot for event_time and knowledge_cutoff; retain original source keys and effective intervals.

records.name: 开关状态观测
records.summary: Record closed/open/unknown, event-time validity, observed_at and evidence. Normal/open design state is not an observed state.

records.name: 电源与分布式电源
records.summary: Available source reachability is a bounded candidate test; unknown DER availability or tie/backfeed paths create uncertainty. Capacity, protection, phase and islanding require separate study.

records.name: 供电点、客户与回路
records.summary: Service points are physical connection scope; customers can own several points and circuit assignment can change. Customer counting follows valid bindings, not point count.

records.name: 计划与实际停电
records.summary: A planned removal is a scenario input. Actual interruption needs observed evidence; neither reachability nor a work order proves a customer interruption.

records.name: 恢复分段
records.summary: Keep per-service-point interruption segments with event intervals and observation evidence; union overlaps before duration totals and preserve repeat interruptions.

records.name: 电气量与边界
records.summary: Retain value, unit, phase/reference context, event time and evidence. Do not infer safe switching or electrical feasibility from a topological path.

records.name: CIM 与交换配置范围
records.summary: The public IEC abstract introduces a shared utility information model; ENTSO-E indexes exchange profiles and their dependencies. Local outage nodes, projections and three-valued decisions are original project choices.
